description: Fork of exp104 (Tiny sparse_scatter, smooth_mode=False, n_alternatives=1) doubling tph for all three LUT modules: qk/v 384 -> 768, out 2048 -> 4096. Per-layer LUT weights double (qk/v 4.72M -> 9.44M, out 4.19M -> 8.39M, per-layer 13.63M -> 27.27M). Total params ~190M. Goal: see how much extra Tiny capacity (more tables, same nap=8 n_sparse=8) closes the gap to exp115 (MHLut+smooth_mode=True, 1.7266 at 108M).
